lines.speaker: control
lines.text: This anchor has no number. It is not on the containment order and it is not on any survey we hold. Two hundred and ninety megawatts.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It has no bind key either. We came through it from the far side of forty-four, which means the far side of forty-four is here.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Deep lattice.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Deep lattice. Also: the bus reading falls about six megawatts a wave and I cannot find where it goes. Nothing on this deck is drawing it.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Restorer is cleared to your board. Forty-four megawatts back for ten drawn and a slot spent.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: So we buy the bus back a piece at a time.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: You buy it back with slots that would otherwise be guns. That's the whole trade and it doesn't get better.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Classification — I don't have one. Reads as pressure.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Most of that was fragments. Same material as the large ones, a fraction of the mass, and they hardly touch the bus at all.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: So they're cheap to send.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Nothing here is being sent, Captain. It's shedding.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Okonkwo, what are we shooting at?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Instruments say a temperature gradient walking at one and a fifth tiles a second. I'd rather not improve on that description.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Capacity's down eighteen since we started. Same six a wave, no variance. It isn't damage — something is *metering* us.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: The wardens spent eleven thousand years standing in front of this.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Facing inward. Yes. I've stopped thinking of them as the enemy, if that's what you're asking.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over — and the ceiling is lower than it was when you built. Shed something or put a restorer up.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. No reading on it after it passed the ring.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Hold what's left. We are not losing an anchor nobody knows exists.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held. Bus reads a hundred and forty-eight of a hundred and ninety.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Does it come back?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It came back to a hundred and eighty-one while I was packing the survey gear. So: mostly.
lines.beat: the loss is not permanent, but it is not fully reversible either, and nobody says so
